description:
After the dev locus migration and v0.3.0 release on the new flow, delete
the now-obsolete machinery:
  - 6 release scripts in scripts/
  - benchbox/release/sync.py, workflow.py, content_validation.py
  - HOLD_BACK_PATHS, ALLOWED_ROOT_FILES, _SOURCES_INCLUDE_PATHS,
    transforms, etc. - all of it
  - test files that covered held-back code or release machinery

Net effect: thousands of lines deleted. The repo gets simpler; future
contributors have less surface area to learn.

This phase lands as a normal PR on public from ~/Developer/benchbox-public
(the new dev locus). Squash-merge.

Plan file: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/single-repo-migration.md (Phase 6).

anti_patterns.why: it tested xdist behaviour that may still apply to the ambient CI in Phase 2; review before removing.
the new release flow depends on it; check it has no transitive imports of the deleted modules first (w6).

anti_patterns.dont: keep "just in case" wrappers around deleted scripts
anti_patterns.why: they accumulate; if you need any of these scripts back, pull them from git history.

anti_patterns.dont: skip the test-suite run in w7
anti_patterns.why: deleting modules silently breaks importers; tests are the cheapest way to find them.

preserves.behavior: The actual benchbox package functionality (CLI, MCP, platforms, benchmarks) is unchanged. Only the release-machinery is removed.
benchbox/release/__init__.py may be retained as an empty stub if the package import structure relies on it; otherwise delete the whole directory.
generate_changelog_entry.py from Phase 3 is retained - the Makefile release target uses it.
update_version.py is retained - the Makefile release target uses it.

verifications.description: scripts/ no longer contains release machinery
benchbox/release/ no longer contains sync or workflow modules
No remaining references to deleted modules
